text: I'll take it off your hands. The hide and bone are yours; the meat's mine.

choices.text: Break down a trophy for me.

why.text: Nothing? I keep the meat, and the city's always hungry. You get every scrap worth having: hide, sinew, plate, whatever it's got. More than you'd cut off it out there with a field knife.

choices.text: Break down a trophy for me.
